title: Advanced Topics in Innovation; Design your Purpose
description: What do you want to do once you graduate? That is the question we tackle in this course. Throughout the semester, you'll use design thinking and lean startup skills and mindsets to explore your personal and professional development goals and explore potential career paths. Using empathy, brainstorming, and prototyping tools, you'll design potential futures for yourself and test them to see if they are a good fit for you.
